name: Komatsubara Taeko
source:
A first year student in Kashima school and Serina's kouhai. Exaggeratedly cheerful, but at the same time can turn into a crybaby for the smallest reasons.

She accidentally became acquainted to Serina via Yukinojou and her childish behavior always rubs Serina the wrong way. Once she's set her mind in something, she goes straight to it.
